scheme_name: Grant to Jharkhand State Unaided Educational Institutions
other_conditions: Institution must be approved by the State Government
Institution must be operated by a registered society or trust under the Societies Registration Act, 1860
Managing committee must be duly constituted and approved by the Jharkhand Academic Council (JAC)
Institution must meet prescribed student‑strength norms
Examination pass rate must be at least 41%
Utilization certificates for previously received grants must be submitted
For intermediate colleges, the institution must be permanently approved by JAC and comply with JAC and Government rules
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance for infrastructure development, educational resources, and staffing support to unaided secondary schools, madrasas, Sanskrit schools, and intermediate colleges in Jharkhand.
documents_required: Utilization certificates for previously received grants
